summary_1line: Hanuman destroys a sacred temple in Lanka, defeats its guards, burns the structure, and proclaims Rama’s coming wrath and the might of the monkey army.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman, gigantic atop a golden-pillared temple, whirls a massive pillar that ignites the sanctuary as flames rise into the Lankan sky.
Surrounded by armed demon guards with darts and scimitars, Hanuman stands roaring on the temple roof while birds and wardens fall stunned below.
With the burning monument behind him, Hanuman hovers in the air proclaiming Rama’s victory and the coming armies of countless monkeys.
